# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and engine stability** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers a focused performance sprint and the Skia m151 engine update. This release ports several hot-path computations to managed C# to eliminate P/Invoke overhead, makes HarfBuzz text shaping allocation-free on common paths, adds .NET 11 WASM support via Emscripten 5.0.6, and incorporates multiple rounds of upstream Skia m151 stability fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine has been updated to milestone m151, and multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 stability and bug fixes have been merged. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was restored to fix a CPU raster quality regression introduced by the m151 upgrade. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — Hex color parsing is now allocation-free and faster; new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads are available for callers that already have span-based strings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **GRContextOptions unsafe modifier removed** — The unnecessary unsafe modifier has been removed from GRContextOptions, making the type usable without enabling unsafe code. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) fixed** — A native handle was leaked when creating a cropped image from encoded data; it is now correctly released. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Performance: SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions moved to managed code** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are now pure managed integer arithmetic, eliminating per-call P/Invoke overhead. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Performance: SKShaper glyph reads via zero-copy spans** — SKShaper now reads glyph results through zero-copy spans rather than marshalling arrays, reducing per-shaping allocations. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Performance: SKFourByteTag.Parse char array allocation eliminated** — SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocates a char[4] on each call. ([#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Platform

- **WASM: .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6** — New static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 enable SkiaSharp on .NET 11 WASM, including support for the new exnref exception-handling model. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 makes the two hottest text-shaping paths allocation-free: Buffer.AddUtf8 now pools its UTF-8 encoding buffer and Tag.Parse no longer allocates a char[4] per call.
